owner: Dr Mouza Al Suwaidi and team
summary: A well established Abu Dhabi dermatology centre appears to lose treatment bookings to misdirected buttons and no on page booking.

findings.problem: The hero and Profhilo Learn More buttons both appear to point to the Sweat Botox page.
findings.cost: Patients interested in Profhilo land on the wrong treatment.
findings.fix: Each button linked to its own treatment page.

findings.problem: The Book Now buttons appear to lead only to a contact page or WhatsApp, with no on page booking form.
findings.cost: Patients who want to book at night or on mobile face extra steps and drop off.
findings.fix: A booking form on the page with date and treatment.

findings.problem: The reviews area appears to show a leftover placeholder line, Rated 5 out of 5, with blanks, and only three reviews appear.
findings.cost: Placeholder text and thin proof weaken high value treatment sales.
findings.fix: Real reviews with names and treatments.

findings.problem: The doctor name appears as Dr. Mouza Al-Suwaidi in the menu and Dr. Mouza Al Suwaidi in the body, and Old Blog appears in the footer.
findings.cost: Small inconsistencies make a premium clinic look careless.
findings.fix: Consistent names and retired old content.
